0 FILE L_Arrivee_Master.mpd
0 Name: L'Arrivee (The Arrival) — Combined Master
0 Author: Grace Balanced Architect + LEGOS-GPT Compiler
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 !LICENCE Redistributable under CCAL version 2.0
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW
0
0 // =================================================================
0 // SCENE: L'Arrivee d'un train en gare de La Ciotat (1895)
0 // CONCEPT: A study in scale and panic. The Duplo engine vs System crowd.
 
0 //
0 // COMBINED:
0 // - Extracted/extended tracks into The_Tracks.ldr (no double-tracks inside locomotive)
0 // - Station re-based to origin so master placement actually matters
0 // - Added Witness_Chorus.ldr (from minifig_family subset) into The_Crowd
0 // - Added "schedule signifier" window sticker element to station slice
0 // =================================================================
0
0 STEP
0 // 0. THE TRACK VECTOR (The Fate Line)
0 // Placement: aligned with locomotive axis
1 7 -160 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Tracks.ldr

0 STEP
0 // 1. THE IRON HORSE (The Threat)
0 // Placement: X=-160 (Left Field), Y=0 (Ground), Z=Centered
1 16 -160 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Locomotive.ldr

0 STEP
0 // 2. THE STATION ARCHITECTURE (The Frame)
0 // Placement: X=100 (Right Field), Y=0 (Ground)
1 16 100 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Station.ldr

0 STEP
0 // 3. THE PANIC (The Reaction)
0 // Placement: Scattered on Platform (right side of track)
1 16 100 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 The_Crowd.ldr

0 NOFILE

0 FILE The_Tracks.ldr
0 Name: Track Vector (Representative Array)
0 Author: Grace
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW
0
0 STEP
0 // Train Track Ramps (85977) providing the cinematic vector

1 7 0 0 -800  1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 -400  1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 0     1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 400   1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 800   1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
1 7 0 0 1200  1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/85977.dat
0
0 NOFILE

0 FILE The_Locomotive.ldr
0 Name: The Duplo Engine
0 Author: Grace
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW
0
0 STEP
0 // -- THE CHASSIS (Duplo Scale) --
0 // Duplo Car Bases (14639) - Massive scale implies weight
0 // Color 0 (Black) for the heavy iron look
1 0 0 -50 -300 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/14639p01.dat
1 0 0 -50 0    1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/14639p01.dat
1 0 0 -50 300  1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/14639p01.dat

0 // -- THE FACE (Cowcatcher) --
0 // Facet Brick (14413) mounted on front
1 72 0 -60 -450 0 0 -1 0 1 0 1 0 0 parts/14413.dat

0 // -- THE PNEUMATICS --
0 // Piping details along the side
1 71 -60 -70 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 parts/14653-f1.dat
1 71  60 -70 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 parts/14653-f1.dat

0 // -- THE STEAM --
0 // Palm Leaves (2518) rotated to explode outwards from wheels
0 // White (15) for steam
1 15  50 -20 -200 0 0 1 0.7 0.7 0 -0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
1 15 -50 -20 -200 0 0 -1 -0.7 0.7 0 0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
1 15  50 -20  200 0 0 1 0.7 0.7 0 -0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
1 15 -50 -20  200 0 0 -1 -0.7 0.7 0 0.7 0.7 0 parts/2518.dat
0
0 NOFILE

0 FILE The_Station.ldr
0 Name: La Ciotat Platform
0 Author: Grace
0 !LDRAW_ORG Model
0 BFC CERTIFY CCW
0
0 STEP
0 // -- THE PLATFORM FLOOR --
0 // Train Bases (303c01) laid flat. Texture = Tiled Floor.
0 // Tan (19)
1 19 0 0 0    1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/303c01.dat
1 19 0 0 300  1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/303c01.dat
1 19 0 0 -300 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/303c01.dat

0 // -- THE GASLIGHTS --
0 // Lampposts (2039) establishing the Z-axis depth
1 0 -20 0 -250 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/2039.dat
1 0 -20 0 0    1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/2039.dat
1 0 -20 0 250  1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/2039.dat

0 // -- THE SKY VAULT (Roof) --
0 // Inverted Boat Hull (18913) - Floating suspension
0 // Trans-Dark Blue (43) for "Iron and Glass" feel
1 43 50 -400 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 0 0 0 1 parts/18913.dat
0 // Secondary Ribs (28535)
1 72 200 -350 -300 -1 0 0 0 -1 0 0 0 1 parts/28535.dat
1 72 200 -350 300  -1 0 0 0 -1 0 0 0 1 parts/28535.dat

0 // -- THE WALL --
0 // Technic Panels (64393)
1 72 150 -50 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 0 1 0 parts/64393.dat

0 // -- THE SIGNIFIER (Schedule Window) --
0 // The stickered "train schedule" glass: pins the scene to "station"
1 16 160 -60 -40 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 parts/3855bd03.dat
0
0 NOFILE

0 Author: Grace

1 14 60 0 -50 0.9 0 0.4 0 1 0 -0.4 0 0.9 parts/4345ap03.dat
1 72 90 0 150 0.7 0 -0.7 0 1 0 0.7 0 0.7 parts/956.dat

0 // -- THE WITNESS CHORUS (System Crowd) --
0 // Representative array: more heads than bodies; you *feel* the mass.
1 16 10 0 -40 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 Witness_Chorus.ldr
1 16 40 0 180 1 0 0 0 1 0 0 0 1 Witness_Chorus.ldr
